{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for sentinel values in revenue
print("Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99:", sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0])

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the cleaning worked
print("First 5 cleaned revenue values:", sales['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Number of refunded orders:", sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0])

# Check for non-converted orders (converted = 0)
print("Number of non-converted orders:", sales[sales['converted'] == 0].shape[0])"}
